cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml'):
        data=z.read(n).decode('utf-8','ignore')
        # strip tags to get run-concatenated text per file
        # find IF markers across runs: remove xml tags
        plain=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',data)
        if 'IF_RELOCATION' in plain or 'RELOCATION' in plain:
            print('FILE:', n)
            for m in re.findall(r'\{\{[^}]*RELOC[^}]*\}\}|IF_RELOCATION|END_IF_RELOCATION', plain):
                print('  marker:', m)
            # show snippet
            idx=plain.find('IF_RELOCATION')
            if idx>=0: print('  snippet:', repr(plain[idx-20:idx+200]))
"
